name: California Franchise Tax Board (FTB) - personal income tax
notes: Researched from public ftb.ca.gov pages only. Web Pay (bank account, free) works without a MyFTB account by logging in with SSN and last name (mapped to the guest lookup, bank only); MyFTB adds viewing, cancelling and scheduling future payments. Credit cards go through ACI Payments (2.3% service fee, also by phone 800-272-9829). Payment plans: $34 setup fee added to the balance, balance up to $25,000 payable within 60 months, all returns for the past 5 years filed; may take up to 90 days. MyFTB sign-in uses a username (inferred from the 'MyFTB login' wording; MFA details not documented on the public pages, left at family default); registration needs recent California return data and is activated by TransUnion identity questions or a mailed PIN letter. No recurring AutoPay for balances is documented; AutoPay marked unsupported (inferred). MyFTB can email you when a notice is sent, but no paper opt-out is documented, so paperless is left at the family default.

guest_pay.note: Web Pay: pay from a checking or savings account for free without a MyFTB account.

autopay.note: FTB does not offer recurring automatic payments for a tax balance. Make each Web Pay payment yourself; with MyFTB you can schedule future payments.

pay_by_phone.note: Credit card payments by phone through ACI Payments (2.3% service fee).

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Pay directly from your bank account through Web Pay for free, pay by credit card for a service fee, or apply for a payment plan if you qualify (setup fee). You can also pay by check or money order, or by electronic funds withdrawal when you e-file.

Send a separate payment for each tax year so it is applied correctly. Your balance keeps accruing interest and penalties until it is paid in full. Be careful with third-party bill payment companies: some charge high fees or look affiliated with FTB when they are not.

help.title: Web Pay (bank account)
paragraphs: Web Pay lets individuals pay a bill or balance due, a current-year or amended return, estimated tax or an extension from a checking or savings account at no cost. You can log in without registering using your Social Security number and the last name on your return.
Paying through a MyFTB account adds the ability to view payments, cancel payments and schedule future payments.
To change a Web Pay request you must cancel it and submit a new one. A request can be cancelled up to 2 business days before the scheduled payment date.

help.title: Pay by credit card
paragraphs: FTB uses ACI Payments to process credit card payments for a bill or balance due, a current-year return, an extension or estimated tax. A 2.3% service fee is added. Pay online with ACI Payments or call 800-272-9829.
Refunds that result from credit card payments may be delayed or need verification. Employers cannot use a credit card for wage garnishment payments.

help.title: Payment plans (installment agreement)
paragraphs: If you cannot pay your tax bill, you can apply for an installment agreement online, by phone at 800-689-4776, or by mail with the payment plan request form. Processing can take up to 90 days; keep paying while you wait to limit interest and penalties.

Individuals may qualify if the amount due is $25,000 or less, it can be paid in 60 months or less, and all income tax returns for the past 5 years are filed. If approved, a $34 setup fee is added to your balance and an acceptance letter is mailed.

You cannot apply online if you already have an installment agreement or have a wage garnishment, bank levy or other collection order; call instead. A financial statement or a tax lien may be required.

help.title: MyFTB account
paragraphs: MyFTB shows your account balance and tax year details, estimated payments and credits, payment history, returns, and notices and correspondence. You can request and manage a payment plan, send secure messages, update contact details and choose to get an email when FTB sends you a notice.

To create an account you need information from a recent California tax return. Activate it right away by answering identity questions from TransUnion, or have a PIN letter mailed to you (5 to 7 business days).
